name: Adnan Baig

bullets: Develop responsive React and Angular applications with reusable components, dashboards and forms, working with product and design teams to clarify requirements.

projects.name: Don't Go Broke
bullets: Built a Next.js/Capacitor finance app with ledger-derived balances, recurring-bill reserves and history-qualified spending projections.
Implemented ownership-scoped Supabase data, one-base-currency checks and transactional JSON restoration that rolls back invalid imports.

projects.name: ReproLab
bullets: Built a browser recorder and debugging workbench capturing masked interactions, errors and network metadata for timeline-based investigation.
Implemented owner-scoped SQLite persistence, duplicate-upload protection and deterministic Playwright regression-test draft generation.

projects.name: dev-clean
bullets: Developed a CLI for JavaScript, Python and Rust workspaces with expiring plans, stale-target validation, reversible quarantine and restore.
Added operation journals, recovery and Git-tracked-file safeguards, with disposable-fixture tests and Linux/macOS/Windows CI.

projects.name: Mart Fight
projects.descriptor: A personal game about school and friendship
bullets: Built a playable browser fighting-game prototype inspired by my school and friendships, with keyboard/touch controls and automated game checks.
Developing toward recognizable fighters based on actual school friends; the full friend roster and online multiplayer remain future goals.
